BiblicalUsage: Yizrᵉʻêʼlîyth means a Jezreelitess. In 1 Samuel 27:3 we read, "And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives..." It appears again in 2 Samuel 2:2: "So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite."
TheologicalSignificance: Yizre'e'liyth is a Jezreelitess, and I believe God put it in his book for a reason, so I want to hear what it says.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
